newsitem.title: USA: TransAmerican Waste has four new directors.
newsitem.headline: TransAmerican Waste has four new directors.

text.p: TransAmerican Waste Industries Inc said Thursday it has elected four new independent directors by replacing two board members and adding two seats.
It said the new members are George Ball, Richard Bean, Philip Burguieres and Robert Moses Jr.
Ball is chairman of Sanders Morris Mundy, an investment bank based in Houston. He is also former chairman and chief executive officer of Prudential Securities and was president of E.F. Hutton & Co.
Bean is executive vice president of Pearce Industries Inc and a director of First City Financial Corp.

Burguieres is chairman of Weatherford Enterra Inc and was former chairman and president of Cameron Iron Works. He is currently director at Texas Commerce Bank, McDermott International and Cogen Technologies.
Moses is a private investor and former chairman of Weatherford Enterra, where he is now chairman of the executive committee.
